global_identity.color_palette: the colors of the product's packaging
global_identity.text_typography: a heavy bold sans for the headline in ALL CAPS, a clean sans for the rest

visual_prompt:
PRODUCT: VITALDROPS. Its bottle reproduced with total fidelity to the attached photo (label, brand name letter by letter, colors).
LAYOUT (UGC testimonial): a mirror selfie with the phone in her hand, natural light, homemade look; the quote in big quotation marks over the photo; fewer graphic blocks; Z5 offer small at the bottom.
MODEL: a 22 years old woman, curvy, dark skin, a messy bun, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup. Emotion: Estilista de 29 años en su salón, entre clienta y clienta, sacando el gotero del bolso. Habla como quien le cuenta un secreto a una amiga, contenta y sin pena..
SETTING: a living room with a sofa and plants. POSE AND FRAMING: standing with crossed legs, front view, knees-up framing.

text_layers.text: TODA MI VIDA ME SALTABA EL DESAYUNO
text_layers.text_style: very bold, ALL CAPS, high contrast, the biggest text

text_layers.text: “Mis gotas me recuerdan comer a mis horas.”
text_layers.text_style: handwritten-like or clean quote style, with quotation marks

text_layers.reference_position: on or next to the bottle
inside or right below the offer

mandatory_visual_elements: the real product from the attached product photo, at least 15% of the image
the woman: a 22 years old woman, curvy, dark skin, a messy bun, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup
final_generation_exclusions: any text closer than 5% to the edges
medical claims, guarantees or invented numbers
brands or logos other than the product

forbidden_additions: prices other than the given offer

language_rule: All visible text in Colombian Spanish, simple, perfectly spelled.
